source: Archived terminal traces and directed game plans in this audit directory
notes: All included games passed headed Google Chrome replay; each accepted action was checked against the public engine. Automatic practice setup history is excluded.
Coverage counts cardPlayed separately from cardFizzled. Games requiring a final reaction decision are excluded from completed counts.
Partner evidence records active effects and earlier successful cards at each event; a shared game alone is not proof of a direct interaction.
The physical cardId is the event cardId; copiedCardId is retained separately. cardInstanceId is retained when supplied by the action.

Successful use means a resolved cardPlayed event, including a card subsequently canceled by Fog. This is not proof of every possible interaction; all three directed Man of Straw games use Fog cancellation.
